heroDescription: The historic Christian faith, held and practised in the Anglican tradition.
intro: Christ The King holds to the historic Anglican faith as expressed in the following:

foundations.title: Scripture
foundations.description: The canonical books of the Old and New Testaments as the inspired Word of God, containing all things necessary for salvation.

foundations.title: Sacraments
foundations.description: Baptism and the Holy Communion (Eucharist) as the two sacraments ordained by Christ himself.

foundations.title: Historic Episcopate
foundations.description: The Historic Episcopate as integral to the apostolic faith and practice.

foundations.title: The Creeds
foundations.description: The three Catholic Creeds: the Apostles' Creed, the Nicene Creed, and the Athanasian Creed.

foundations.title: Church Councils
foundations.description: The teaching of the first four Councils of the undivided Church, and the Christological clarifications of councils five through seven.

foundations.title: Book of Common Prayer
foundations.description: The 1662 Book of Common Prayer as the doctrinal standard for Anglican worship.

foundations.title: Thirty-Nine Articles
foundations.description: The Thirty-Nine Articles of Religion (1571) as expressing authentic Anglican belief.
